contradictions.source: et essendo rimaso uno suo figliuolo, et due suoi fratelli, furono a tempo a uendicare il morto.
contradictions.english: and one of his sons and two of his brothers having remained, they were in time to avenge the dead man.
contradictions.why: The English implies the son and brothers avenged the Duke, whereas the source says the conspirators were in time to avenge the dead man (by killing the survivors).
